# ParCool 4.0.1.5 for Fabric 26.3 - port build 4
Unofficial Fabric port of **ParCool! 4.0.1.5** (by alRex_U) for **Minecraft 26.3**. Replaces the old 3.4 port (mc26.3-port.1).

**Requires:** Fabric Loader 0.20.0+, Fabric API (26.3), Forge Config API Port 26.3.0+, Java 25. Architectury API is no longer needed.
Optional: Mod Menu.

**Install:** put the jar into your `mods` folder and remove any older ParCool jar (two ParCool jars don't start). Back up your world first.

**New compared to the 3.4 port:** everything from ParCool 4.0: grappling hook, skill tree, long jump, new animations and sounds, the in-game guide and the Alt+P settings tablet.

**Changes in this port:**
- All actions are available from the start: the skill tree is off by default (it can be switched on in the server config)
- The stamina bar sits in its own row above the hunger bar, so it no longer covers the food or air bubbles
- Vault: no launch at the end, no vault without room to land behind the obstacle, no vault at doorways in 1-block walls
- Settings tablet, skill tree and other ParCool screens react to the left mouse button again (26.3 reads the mouse through SDL, where left is button 1)
- Fixed crashes: shooting the grappling hook, dedicated servers
- Zipline sound through the vanilla lead sound; recipes in the 26.3 format (the chain is the iron chain)
- The temporary debug lines in the log are gone (new in port build 4)

This is an unofficial port. Report problems in this repository's Issues, not to the original author.
License: LGPL-3.0, full source code in this repository (branch `port/4.0`).
